p2r10.note: Sharper channels: a wheel-equivalent source-power channel (0.30 x fuel + 0.90 x battery) next to the road-load channels (feature version 4)

p2r11.note: Physics-regression head: the road-load fit's normal equations pooled over a car's trips and solved; mass = b0 x a learned efficiency correction

p2r12.note: Pooled multi-trip training: 90 % of samples pool 2-8 trips (was 65 %), 32 cars per batch

p2r13.note: GPU: wider CNN (48-192 channels, 160-d embedding) trained 8,000 steps
